label: Sauto

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). Sauto.cz documents an XML-RPC/FastRPC import interface free for all registered (dealer) clients; upload only, no search API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.sauto.cz/dokumentace-importu): Sauto.cz documents an XML-RPC/FastRPC import interface free for all registered (dealer) clients; upload only, no search API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
